evidence_notes: Diagnosed 8 months ago. Also COPD and arthritis. Started with stomach flu symptoms, lasted months, lost 50lbs. Prednisone worsened breathing; respiratory doctor advised against it. Now on budesonide (minimal help, 20%). GI wants biologics, but lung doctor says too risky due to COPD and infection risk. Stuck with inadequate treatment. Quality of life is very poor (breathing, eating, mobility issues). Wife died 2 years ago. Children busy. Considering moving in with son, but wife is reluctant. Grandchildren's smiles keep him going. Worried about future. Continues treatment despite poor outlook.
